headline: Sensex zooms 1,534 points and Nifty hits 23,000 as IT and banking stocks lead a massive market rally

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong performance in IT, auto, and private banking sectors led the market surge
Positive sentiment surrounding the Jio Platforms IPO press conference and reservation details
Tech Mahindra and Wipro shares gained significantly ahead of their Q2 earnings reports
Robust domestic sentiment following a 13.2% rise in net direct tax collections
whatHappening: The Sensex jumped 1,534 points while the Nifty 50 closed at the 23,000 milestone
South Indian Bank reported a 21% rise in Q2 net profit to ₹426 crore with improved asset quality
Tata Communications posted an 86% year-on-year jump in net profit reaching ₹341 crore
HDFC AMC shares faced pressure after reporting a 10.5% fall in net profit and a 9% dip in income
summary: The Indian stock market witnessed a spectacular rally today, with the Sensex surging 1,534 points and Nifty hitting the 23,000 mark. Gains were driven by the IT and banking sectors, alongside strong Q2 results from Tata Communications and South Indian Bank. Investor confidence was further bolstered by robust direct tax collection data and updates regarding the Jio Platforms IPO.
